result.instructions: Tools for Ecwid, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ecwid data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run ecwid_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ecwid_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ecwid_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. ecwid_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ecwid_get_store_profile
tools.title: Get store profile
tools.description: Get the store's profile — general info (store id, name, currency), company details, and settings. Ecwid REST: GET /profile.

tools.name: ecwid_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search / list the store's products with optional filters (keyword, SKU, category, stock, price range) and sorting. Returns a paged collection ({total, count, offset, limit, items}). Ecwid REST: GET /products.

keyword.description: Full-text search term (matches title, description, SKU…).

category.description: Filter to products in this category id (0 = root).

inStock.description: Filter to in-stock (true) or out-of-stock (false) products.

enabled.description: Filter to enabled (true) or disabled (false) products.

sortBy.description: Sort order: RELEVANCE | PRICE_ASC | PRICE_DESC | NAME_ASC | NAME_DESC | ADDED_TIME_ASC | ADDED_TIME_DESC | UPDATED_TIME_ASC | UPDATED_TIME_DESC.

tools.name: ecwid_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get a single product by its id, including price, stock, options, images, and category assignments. Ecwid REST: GET /products/{productId}.

tools.name: ecwid_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search / list the store's orders with optional filters (keyword, customer email/id, payment & fulfillment status, coupon, created-date range). Returns a paged collection. Ecwid REST: GET /orders.

keyword.description: Full-text search term (order number, customer name, email…).

payment_status.description: Filter by payment status: AWAITING_PAYMENT | PAID | CANCELLED | REFUNDED | PARTIALLY_REFUNDED | INCOMPLETE.

fulfillment_status.description: Filter by fulfillment status: AWAITING_PROCESSING | PROCESSING | SHIPPED | DELIVERED | WILL_NOT_DELIVER | RETURNED | READY_FOR_PICKUP | OUT_FOR_DELIVERY.

created_from.description: Filter to orders created on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or Unix timestamp).

created_to.description: Filter to orders created on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or Unix timestamp).

tools.name: ecwid_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get a single order by its order number, including line items, totals, customer, and payment/fulfillment status. Ecwid REST: GET /orders/{orderNumber}.

tools.name: ecwid_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Search / list the store's customers with optional filters (keyword, email, name, customer group). Returns a paged collection. Ecwid REST: GET /customers.

tools.name: ecwid_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get a single customer by id, including contact details, addresses, and customer group. Ecwid REST: GET /customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: ecwid_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the store's product categories, optionally scoped to a parent category and including hidden ones. Returns a paged collection. Ecwid REST: GET /categories.

parent.description: List only subcategories of this parent category id (0 = root).

tools.name: ecwid_get_category
tools.title: Get category
tools.description: Get a single category by id, including its name, parent, product ids, and images. Ecwid REST: GET /categories/{categoryId}.

tools.name: ecwid_list_discount_coupons
tools.title: List discount coupons
tools.description: List the store's discount coupons with optional filters (coupon code, discount type, availability). Returns a paged collection. Ecwid REST: GET /discount_coupons.

discount_type.description: Filter by discount type, e.g. ABS | PERCENT | SHIPPING | ABS_AND_SHIPPING | PERCENT_AND_SHIPPING.

availability.description: Filter by availability, e.g. ACTIVE | PAUSED | EXPIRED | COMPLETE.

tools.name: ecwid_adjust_product_inventory
tools.title: Adjust product inventory
tools.description: ADJUSTS a product's in-stock quantity by a delta — this MODIFIES live store data. Positive increases stock, negative decreases it. Ecwid REST: PUT /products/{productId}/inventory with JSON body {quantityDelta}. Returns {updateCount, warning?}.

quantity_delta.description: Change in stock quantity — positive increases stock, negative decreases.

tools.name: ecwid_update_order
tools.title: Update order
tools.description: UPDATES an order — its payment status, fulfillment status, and/or tracking number. This MODIFIES live store data and may trigger customer notifications. Ecwid REST: PUT /orders/{orderNumber}. Provide only the fields you want to change. Returns {updateCount}.

payment_status.description: New payment status: AWAITING_PAYMENT | PAID | CANCELLED | REFUNDED | PARTIALLY_REFUNDED | INCOMPLETE.

fulfillment_status.description: New fulfillment status: AWAITING_PROCESSING | PROCESSING | SHIPPED | DELIVERED | WILL_NOT_DELIVER | RETURNED | READY_FOR_PICKUP | OUT_FOR_DELIVERY.

tracking_number.description: Shipping tracking number to record on the order.
